principle_violations.reason: The Order class is handling the responsibilities of maintaining the order details (items, quantities, prices) and also modifying its own status upon payment, while PaymentProcessor subclasses are responsible for payment processing and also change the order status.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the function of changing the order status into a dedicated class or method that can be invoked after a successful payment, preventing the order class from knowing about payment processing.

overall_feedback: 1 principle violation found. Please see the details below.
